_comment: Graphics Quality tiers (docs/PHASE7_PLAN.md D11, D13). Read by scripts/build-assets.mjs and client/src/game/assets.ts. Paths are relative to NoBu-Shooter/assets (the masters). Files listed in `scaled` are stored at `scales[tier]` of their size; every other image is the same in every tier. Images in `lossy` are lossy WebP, the rest lossless WebP. Every sound becomes OGG Vorbis at `audio[tier]`.
